title: GET /api/explain 200
description: Why one card scores what it does for a query: each relevance branch of the query replayed against that one card. A pre-v1 endpoint, described here unchanged. A card the index does not hold is an answer, not an error: found is false, every branch is unmatched with score 0 and carries neither description nor components. A malformed id or a missing or over-long q is a 400, error.json.

q.description: The trimmed query, at most 256 characters.

found.description: Whether the index holds a card with that id.

score.description: The sum of the matched branches' scores, rounded to three decimals: the score the card is ranked by.

name.description: The branch's name, the same one search reports in matched.

score.description: What this branch contributes alone; 0 when it did not match.

description.description: Present only when the engine named the operation: how the branch's components combine, which can be a sum or the largest of them.

components.description: Present only when the engine reported terms: the explanation's immediate children, with the engine's own unrounded values. They do not necessarily add up to the branch's score; read the description.
